description: Repositories that reshape the user-level layer of a Claude Code install - context, directives, procedures, and capability that are in place before any task is known.
thesis: Replace an eagerly-loaded bulk with a lean always-on pointer plus on-demand retrieval, applied to each slot of the user-level layer.

slots.name: standing-directives
slots.governs: marker-delimited habits block inside the always-on file

slots.name: procedures
slots.governs: private SOP library, path held in plugin config

slots.name: capability
slots.governs: installed plugins, skills and MCP tool descriptions

components.name: Split-Claude-MD-Pattern
components.summary: Lean ~30-50 line entrypoint plus a pointer to context/. Documents that Claude Code's CLAUDE.md loading is additive across directory levels, and that ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/CLAUDE.md are both picked up.
components.key_constraint: Split on rule-versus-lookup, not on file size. A directive moved behind a pointer stops being followed.

components.name: Claude-User-Context-Pattern
components.summary: Depersonalised, forkable ~/.claude/ layer: lean top-level file routing to topical context/*.md files with <placeholders> for personal specifics.
components.key_constraint: Pointer entries need a read-it-when trigger, not just a filename. priority="critical" marks files to consult eagerly without inlining them.

components.name: User-Claude-MD-Plugin
components.summary: Operates on the user-level layer: chunk-user-claude, user-claude-health, list-user-context, edit-user-context.
components.key_constraint: Pointer drift is the decay mode. A stale pointer is worse than a missing one.

components.name: Habits-Of-Claude
components.summary: One file per standing habit, assembled into a pasteable markdown block and a JSON index, spliced into a marker-delimited region of the target prompt.
components.key_constraint: The spliced region is a build target. Hand-edits inside the markers are overwritten. Environment facts belong in the context store, not in habits/.

components.name: Document-As-You-Go
components.summary: Drop-in system prompt and slash command making agents capture what they discover instead of losing it at session end.
components.key_constraint: Superseded in mechanism, not retired - still the clearest single-habit demonstration.

components.name: Claude-SOPs
components.summary: Standard operating procedures as a private versioned markdown library read on demand: one CLAUDE.md pointer, one index, one procedure per run.
components.key_constraint: Machinery public, procedures private - easy to get backwards. A context file says how things are; an SOP says what to do, in order, to reach an outcome.

components.name: Claude-Vault
components.summary: Meta-plugin holding a vault of dormant plugins and MCP servers, activated per project, against eager plugin-description loading at user level.
components.key_constraint: Adopt last - not reversible in a single edit, and the saving is illegible until the text side of the budget has shrunk.

components.name: Claude-Rudder
components.scope_note: Listed for its chunk-claude / context-health-check half only. Its MCP and feedback primitives are out of scope for this index.
components.summary: The same split one level down, at repo level: chunk-claude, context-health-check, should-i-start-fresh.
components.key_constraint: The user and project layers must agree on their boundary - project knowledge in the repo's context/, machine and workflow knowledge at user level.

evidence.name: Claude-Context-Analysis-0526
evidence.measures: Redacted point-in-time /context dump from a heavily-pluginned session: where the budget goes, what is eager versus lazy.

evidence.name: State-Of-Claude-Context-0426
evidence.measures: Q&A notes on where context bloat accrues given the harness's current shape and primitives.

related_indexes.name: Claude-Code-Projects-Index
related_indexes.territory: All Claude Code work - workspaces, plugins, templates. Authoritative on repo existence and descriptions; this index is authoritative on slot and composition.
